consolidated.src: ar26 Directors' report financial highlights; consolidated note 59 (segments)

fy26.impairment: ₹4,349 cr standalone exceptional charge in FY26 (₹4,300 cr for the Brazil BM-SEAL-11 venture after the FPSO tender took ~3 years and first oil slipped to FY31); ₹1,774 cr in FY25. Consolidated exceptional items only ₹411 cr (FY26) because the group had already carried the assets lower.

q1fy27.exceptionalNote: ₹1,884.56 cr gain from reclassifying the foreign-currency translation reserve to profit when IBV Brasil Petroleo became a subsidiary (BPRL bought the remaining 39% JV stake; IBV holds 40% of BM-SEAL-11). A one-off: E&P's Q1 segment profit of ₹2,084 cr is mostly this gain.

lpg.src: q1press; moslq1 (₹53.8bn gross, ~₹510/cylinder Q1, ₹490 July); plq1 (₹210 expected for August)

call.crude: Spot purchases 69% of crude (44% a year earlier); Russian crude ~38% of imports; crude premium over the Indian basket >US$15/bbl after the conflict (US$4-5 before); Russian discounts 'largely disappeared'. August crude fully tied up.
call.refining: GRM US$41.4/bbl before SAED and road cess, US$17.0 after; Bina US$56, Kochi US$39, Mumbai US$34. Distillate yield Bina 87%, Kochi 85%.
call.marketing: Implied gross marketing margin a loss of ~₹5.4-5.5/litre after SAED (PL, MOSL); retail throughput 157 KL per outlet per month; ~80% of fuel sourced from own refineries.
call.projects: Bina petchem and refinery expansion (₹49,800 cr; 7.8 → 11 MMTPA + 2.2 MMTPA petchem) 30.7% complete, ₹5,900 cr spent, commissioning by 2028; Mumbai PRFCC (~₹14,000 cr) 7%, Sep-2029; Kochi polypropylene (~₹5,000 cr, 400 KTPA) ~40%, May-2028; Andhra Pradesh 9 MMTPA refinery-petchem complex: environmental clearance expected Q2FY27 (not yet sanctioned).
call.upstream: Mozambique LNG Area 1 (BPRL 10%): construction ~42%, project finance agreed, first LNG mid-2028 (FY29), group entitlement ~1.3 MMTPA, no further equity from BPCL. Brazil BM-SEAL-11 (40% via IBV, now 100% owned): first oil FY31, gas FY32, ~88 kbpd peak; BPRL equity ~US$1.2bn over 3-4 years. Lower Zakum (UAE) producing; Onshore Block 1 discoveries.
call.capex: FY27 capex guidance ₹25,000 cr kept (Q1 ₹4,430 cr); could reach ₹26,000-27,000 cr. Split: refinery + petchem ~₹11,000 cr, marketing ~₹10,000 cr, BPRL equity ~₹2,250 cr, CGD ~₹1,700 cr. Peak group debt/equity no more than 1:1; comfortable at 0.3-0.4.
